children: Forgent Power Solutions reported record fiscal fourth-quarter revenue of $461.7 million and net income of $66.1 million for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, as adjusted EBITDA reached a company high of $112.7 million. Full-year 2026 revenues were $1.420 billion with net income of $106.0 million, and the company initiated fiscal 2027 guidance of $2.4–$2.6 billion in revenue and $575–$625 million in adjusted EBITDA. Management cited accelerating demand and a record $3.0 billion backlog entering fiscal 2027 alongside capacity expansion investments in Tijuana.
Quarterly gross profit: $166,695 and gross margin (reported) from table (gross profit figure provided)
Operating income (Income from operations) for the quarter: $91,899
Quarterly net income: $66,094; Net income attributable to the company: $53,298
Adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP) for the quarter: $112,736; Adjusted EBITDA for FY2026: $322,904
Adjusted diluted EPS (non-GAAP) for the quarter: $0.25; Adjusted EPS for FY2027 guidance: $1.26–$1.40
Bookings reached a company record of $1.503 billion in the fourth quarter, driving a 3.3x book-to-bill ratio and a record backlog of $3.0 billion as of June 30, 2026.
Revenue growth accelerated sharply: Q4 revenues rose 94% year-over-year; full-year 2026 revenues grew 89% versus prior year.

Powertrain Solutions (modular solutions) grew 259% in fiscal 2026 and accounted for nearly one-third of Q4 revenue, prompting a $35 million incremental capacity expansion at the Tijuana campus to increase PTS capacity by more than 50%.

Capital investment and ramp activity: fiscal 2026 capex included substantial build-out spend (Q4 capex $31 million tied to prior capacity expansion); FY2027 capex expected to be approximately $87 million, including the incremental PTS expansion and maintenance capital (~1% of revenue).

Operational cash flow and working capital: cash flow from operations was $74 million in Q4 and $109.1 million for the year, with management expecting operating cash flow to increase in fiscal 2027 as production ramps continue.
